Definition: Country identifiers.
definition_zh: 國家識別碼。

Definition: Whether the country appears in each ISSP/ISPSS wave.
definition_zh: 該國是否納入各期 ISSP／ISPSS 調查。

Definition: Calendar year, 2001-2022.
Total resident population. World Bank WDI SP.POP.TOTL, mid-year, for 39 countries; Taiwan is the MOI year-end registered population.
Caution / verification: Verified: all 858 World Bank values come from the archived live API response; the 507 for 2010-2022 matched on 2026-08-17 and again on 2026-10-07.
definition_zh: 總居住人口。39 國採世界銀行 WDI SP.POP.TOTL 年中人口；臺灣為內政部年底戶籍登記人口。
caution_zh: 已查證：858 筆世界銀行數值皆來自所存檔之線上 API 回應；其中 2010–2022 年之 507 筆於 2026-08-17 及 2026-10-07 兩度比對一致。

Definition: Alternative population from UN WPP 2024, total population at 1 July, for all 40 countries including Taiwan.
Caution / verification: Verified: all 880 values come from the archived UN WPP 2024 file; the 520 for 2010-2022 matched on 2026-08-17 and again on 2026-10-07.
definition_zh: 替代之人口數，來自 UN WPP 2024，為 7 月 1 日總人口，涵蓋全部 40 國（含臺灣）。
caution_zh: 已查證：880 筆數值皆來自所存檔之 UN WPP 2024 檔案；其中 2010–2022 年之 520 筆於 2026-08-17 及 2026-10-07 兩度比對一致。

Definition: Percentage gap between the two population series.
Caution / verification: Use to see where the choice of population denominator matters.
definition_zh: 兩組人口序列之百分比差距。
caution_zh: 可用以檢視人口分母之選擇在何處會造成實質影響。

Definition: Residents born outside the reporting country.
Caution / verification: Includes naturalised citizens, so it exceeds foreign_nationals almost everywhere.
definition_zh: 出生於報告國以外之居住人口。
caution_zh: 已包含歸化取得公民身分者，故幾乎在所有國家都高於外國籍人口。

Definition: Residents holding foreign citizenship, including stateless where reported.
Caution / verification: Conceptually the closest available match to "non-nationals" using public healthcare. RECOMMENDED as the main cross-national regressor.
definition_zh: 持有外國國籍之居住人口，含有通報之無國籍者。
caution_zh: 概念上最接近「非本國籍」使用公費醫療之對象。建議作為跨國分析之主要自變項。

Definition: Estimated number of foreign nationals resident without authorisation.
Caution / verification: WEAK. 12/40 countries. Methods not comparable across countries. Not extended before 2010.
definition_zh: 推估之未經許可居留外國人數。
caution_zh: 薄弱。12／40 國。各國方法不可比。2010 年以前未延伸。

Definition: Administrative register count of persons remaining beyond authorised stay.
Caution / verification: WEAK. 6/40 countries. A register count, not a modelled stock. Not extended before 2010.
definition_zh: 逾期停留者之行政登記數。
caution_zh: 薄弱。6／40 國。為登記統計數，並非模型推估之存量。2010 年以前未延伸。

Definition: Taiwan only: Ministry of Labor count of absconded / missing migrant workers (失聯移工).
Caution / verification: A SUBSET of overstayers. Kept separate so it is never read as the same series.
definition_zh: 僅臺灣：勞動部統計之失聯移工人數。
caution_zh: 屬逾期停留者之部分集合。獨立列出以免被誤讀為同一序列。

Definition: Third-country nationals found to be illegally present during the year.
Caution / verification: A FLOW of enforcement events, NOT a stock, and not a count of persons - one person can be detected more than once.
definition_zh: 該年度查獲之非法居留第三國國民人次。
caution_zh: 屬執法事件之「流量」而非人口「存量」，亦非人數統計——同一人可能被查獲多次。

Definition: Variable divided by population (proportion, not percent).
definition_zh: 該變項除以總人口（比例，非百分比）。

Definition: Detections per 1,000 residents.
Caution / verification: Provided because a raw flow is not comparable to a stock share.
definition_zh: 每千名居民之查獲人次。
caution_zh: 因原始流量數與存量占比不可比較，故另行提供。

Definition: Reference date of the underlying measurement.
Caution / verification: Eurostat/OECD stocks are 1 January; Taiwan and Korea are 31 December; Japan is 1 January.
definition_zh: 底層測量之基準日。
caution_zh: Eurostat／OECD 存量為 1 月 1 日；臺灣與南韓為 12 月 31 日；日本為 1 月 1 日。

Definition: Provenance of each value.
definition_zh: 各數值之出處資訊。

Definition: Data-quality grade for that cell. A = re-derived from a machine-readable official source and matched exactly, or corrected against one during this verification. B = the published figure appears in the retrieved source document. C = derived from the source rather than published by it (see *_derived and *_published_range). Values that could not be traced to an archived source were deleted, so no grade D remains.
Caution / verification: Every retained value is traceable to an archived source file.
definition_zh: 該儲存格之資料品質等級。A＝自機器可讀之官方來源重新計算並完全一致，或於本次查證中依該來源更正。B＝經閱讀所取得之來源文件確認。C＝已取得來源文件，但該數值為推估值，無法以機械方式重新導出。D＝所引用之來源已無法取得。
caution_zh: 本典藏保留之每一筆數值，均可追溯至一份存檔之來源檔案。

Definition: Flag: "yes" when the cell is derived from the source rather than published by it.
Caution / verification: Marked with ≈ on the website. 15 such values: 13 are midpoints of published ranges and 2 are the difference of two published rows (UK foreign-born 2004-2005).
definition_zh: 旗標：當該儲存格之數值係自來源推導而得、而非由來源直接公布時，標示為 "yes"。
caution_zh: 網站上以 ≈ 標示。共 15 筆：13 筆為已公布區間之中點，2 筆為兩個已公布列之差（英國外國出生 2004–2005 年）。

Definition: How the value was derived, e.g. "midpoint of the published range".
Caution / verification: Empty when the value is published directly by the source.
definition_zh: 說明該數值如何推導而得，例如「已公布區間之中點」。
caution_zh: 若數值由來源直接公布，本欄為空白。

Definition: The range the source actually publishes, where it publishes a range rather than a point estimate.
Caution / verification: Use the range, not the derived midpoint, for any claim about level.
definition_zh: 來源實際公布之區間；適用於來源公布區間而非單一點估計之情形。
caution_zh: 若要對水準值提出任何主張，應引用該區間，而非推導所得之中點。

Definition: Kind of source behind a foreign_born or foreign_nationals value: annual (official annual series such as Eurostat, OECD, MOI), census, survey (household-survey estimate), un_estimate (UN DESA model estimate) or other.
Caution / verification: Filter on this to keep only annual series.
definition_zh: 外國出生或外國籍人口數值所依據之來源類型：annual（Eurostat、OECD、內政部等官方逐年序列）、census（普查）、survey（家戶調查估計）、un_estimate（UN DESA 模型估計）或 other。
caution_zh: 依此欄篩選即可僅保留逐年序列。

Definition: Comparability flags on a foreign_born or foreign_nationals value, separated by semicolons: splice (source differs from the one used for the rest of the series), splice (large gap) (and the two sources differ by 5% or more where they overlap), un_estimate, declared citizenship basis, comparability caution, includes former-USSR births, derived by subtraction, and the publisher's own flags (Eurostat: break in time series, estimated, provisional).
Caution / verification: Blank means no flag. Attached to every cell, including those published before the extension (UN DESA estimates and the flags Eurostat itself attached). See the cell note and data/extension_splice_summary.csv.
definition_zh: 外國出生或外國籍人口數值之可比性旗標，以分號分隔：splice（來源與序列其餘部分不同）、splice (large gap)（且兩來源於重疊年度相差 5% 以上）、un_estimate、declared citizenship basis、comparability caution、includes former-USSR births、derived by subtraction，以及發布機構自身之旗標（Eurostat：時間序列斷裂、估計值、暫定值）。
caution_zh: 空白表示無旗標。適用於每一格，包括延伸前已發布者（UN DESA 估計值與 Eurostat 自身之旗標）。請參閱各筆備註與 data/extension_splice_summary.csv。

Definition: Date a value was collected, for values added in the 2001 extension (2026-10-07); blank for values collected on 2026-08-17.
Caution / verification: Present for population, population_un_wpp2024, foreign_born and foreign_nationals.
definition_zh: 數值蒐集之日期：2001 年延伸所新增之數值為 2026-10-07；於 2026-08-17 蒐集者則為空白。
